sentences.text: The National Advisory Committee on Immunization has modified its recommendations on immunization schedules to take into account the licensure of new or improved vaccines and immune globulins.
Changes in recommended schedules for immunization of infants and children have been made by the National Advisory Committee on Immunization.
Following a standard immunization schedule ensures maximal achievable protection for children against infectious diseases.
Interruption of a recommended immunization series does not require starting the series over again, regardless of the interval elapsed.

answer.text: The National Advisory Committee on Immunization has modified its recommendations on immunization schedules to take into account the licensure of new or improved vaccines and immune globulins. Changes in recommended schedules for immunization of infants and children have been made by the National Advisory Committee on Immunization. Following a standard immunization schedule ensures maximal achievable protection for children against infectious diseases. Interruption of a recommended immunization series does not require starting the series over again, regardless of the interval elapsed.
